'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Sierra Leone coup attempt]]
**A high court in [[Sierra Leone]] sentences eleven people, including [[Republic of Sierra Leone Armed Forces|soldiers]] and [[Sierra Leone Police|police officers]], to 40 to 70 years in prison for their roles in the failed military [[coup]] last year. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/sierra-leone-jails-11-soldiers-police-officers-over-coup-attempt-2024-07-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Bangladesh quota reform movement]]
**A court in the [[United Arab Emirates]] sentences 57 [[Bangladeshis]] to prison, including three to [[life sentence]]s, for holding protests against the [[Bangladesh government]] in the United Arab Emirates, where protesting is illegal. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/crgk8gnpg0zo (BBC News)]
*[[Animal rights in Colombia]]
**[[President of Colombia]] [[Gustavo Petro]] signs into law a bill outlawing [[bullfighting]] and ordering all [[bullring]]s to be converted into cultural or alternative sporting venues by 2027. [https://apnews.com/article/colombia-bullfighting-ban-a7b7d0a8f87abef0e79c4eec693af574 (AP)]
*[[Daruvar shooting]]
**Six people are killed and six others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a [[nursing home]] in [[Daruvar]], [[Croatia]]. The perpetrator is arrested. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/five-reported-killed-croatian-nursing-home-media-2024-07-22/ (Reuters)]
*A [[Canada|Canadian]] citizen is shot and killed by [[Israeli police]] after he attempts to stab [[Israeli soldiers]] and security personnel at the entrance to the [[Netiv HaAsara]] [[moshav]], near the border with the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/canadian-killed-in-stabbing-attempt-in-southern-israel/3282158 (Anadolu Agency)]
*A court in [[Russia]] sentences [[Russian-American]] journalist [[Alsu Kurmasheva]] to six and a half years in prison in a secret trial. [https://www.dw.com/en/russia-jails-us-russian-journalist-kurmasheva/a-69734566 (DW)]
